استغفرن (form X)
# اِسْتَغْفَرْنَ (istaḡfarna) /is.taɣ.far.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
# اُسْتُغْفِرْنَ (ustuḡfirna) /us.tuɣ.fir.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
# اِسْتَغْفِرْنَ (istaḡfirna) /is.taɣ.fir.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَغْفَرَ (istaḡfara)
